name: Club Fair
description: Kicked off the semester with interactive squash games and outreach activities. Target-hitting challenges and phrase-guessing with headphones attracted huge footfall.
highlight: Strong student turnout, effective awareness platform

name: Team Tryouts
description: 15 men and 7 women competed over two days in a round-robin format. Final selection: 7 men (5 + 2 reserves) and 6 women (5 + 1 reserve).
highlight: 22 participants across two days of intense competition

name: Squash Ladder Tournament — Edition 1
description: In collaboration with DotSlash. Knockout format at Arjuna Squash Courts. Established the official FLAME Squash Ladder Leaderboard with top 20 active players.
highlight: First ever FLAME Squash Ladder established

name: Interhouse Squash Tournament (Girls)
description: All four FLAME houses competed. Chanakya won the women's final against Vivekananda with a confident performance.

name: Interhouse Squash Tournament (Boys)
description: High-energy men's division with Kalidas securing victory over Vivekananda in the final.

name: Sports Takeover Stall
description: Collaborated with Tennis and Fitness Club for an interactive stall with squash games and student engagement activities.

name: Interactive Session with Paarth Ambani
description: International squash player from Columbia University shared insights on training, match preparation, fitness, and balancing academics with high-level sport.

name: FLAME Squash Championship (FSC)
description: Marquee inter-college tournament with 70+ registrations from across Maharashtra. Four categories: U-17 Boys, U-17 Girls, Men's, Women's. Sponsors: VYBE Studios & Yodda Trybbe.

name: Winter Carnival Stall
description: Collaborated with First-Cut at the Winter Carnival. Squash ball balancing game attracted large crowds in a festive setting.

name: Friendlies — Start Academy
description: Round-robin friendly matches with Start Academy. Players tested skills against diverse playing styles.

name: Squash Ladder Tournament — Edition 2
description: Round-robin format open to all FLAME students. Top 20 players selected for the FLAME Squash Ladder Leaderboard, with challenge matches to move up.

name: FirstCut Finale Carnival Stall
description: Interactive squash accuracy game — throwing balls into cups at varying distances — drew enthusiastic participation at the FirstCut Finale Carnival.

name: FLAME Racketlon Managers Meet
description: Preparatory meet for Racketlon 2026 covering tournament structure, auction rules, roster regulations, and match formats.

name: FLAME Racketlon Auctions
description: 8 teams (Raging Rhinos, Phoenix Cavaliers, Vicious Vipers, Valor Stags, Tornado Stallions, Lunar Leopards, Neon Knights, Forest Ravens) bid for players with 50,000 credits each.

name: FLAME Racketlon 2026
description: Multi-sport racket tournament across Badminton, Table Tennis, Tennis & Squash. 8 teams, knockout format, 9 match categories. Champions: Neon Knights (₹10,000). Runners-up: Lunar Leopards (₹4,000).

name: AIU Squash Tournament
description: FLAME represented at the national university-level AIU Squash Tournament in Mumbai. Both men's and women's teams advanced to Pre-Quarterfinals.

name: Squash Ladder Tournament — Edition 3
description: Final edition for the year. Priyaan, Maanvir, and Dhwani emerged as the top three players.

name: NMIMS Fury Tournament
description: Inter-collegiate tournament with players from multiple institutions. Priyaan Thakkar won his category. Japman reached QF, Maanvir reached pre-QF.

name: Friendlies — NDA & Poona Club
description: Round-robin friendlies with National Defence Academy and Poona Squash Club. 15–20 participants in a relaxed yet competitive format.

name: Kurukshetra Carnival Stall
description: Sack relay and reflex relay games at the Kurukshetra Carnival introduced students to squash skills in a fun, active format.
highlight: Agility & reflex training disguised as fun
